name: randomBytes
description: Returns cryptographically secure random bytes as a Binary value, backed by the operating system CSPRNG. CFML has no primitive for raw entropy — generateSecretKey() only yields cipher-shaped key lengths as base64 text — so this covers PBKDF2 salts, nonces and opaque tokens. Count must be greater than 0 and at most 16777216 (16 MiB); a typo'd huge number fails loudly instead of exhausting memory. Available when the security cargo feature is enabled.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of random bytes to generate (1 to 16777216).
